content.text: Let me check what the age bracket labels look like and understand the reimbursement columns better:

input.sql: SELECT * FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_AGE_BRACKET ORDER BY AGE_BEN_SNDS

content.text: Good! Now let me query the reimbursements data for January 2025, excluding the unknown age bracket, and sum the reimbursement amounts by age bracket:

input.sql:
SELECT 
    ab.AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB as age_bracket,
    SUM(fr.PRS_REM_MNT + fr.FLT_REM_MNT) as total_reimbursed
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_AGE_BRACKET ab ON fr.AGE_BEN_SNDS = ab.AGE_BEN_SNDS
WHERE fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501  -- January 2025
    AND fr.AGE_BEN_SNDS != 99  -- Exclude unknown age
GROUP BY ab.AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB
ORDER BY ab.AGE_BEN_SNDS

SELECT 
    ab.AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB as age_bracket,
    SUM(fr.PRS_REM_MNT + fr.FLT_REM_MNT) as total_reimbursed
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_AGE_BRACKET ab ON fr.AGE_BEN_SNDS = ab.AGE_BEN_SNDS
WHERE fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501  -- January 2025
    AND fr.AGE_BEN_SNDS != 99  -- Exclude unknown age
GROUP BY ab.AGE_BEN_SNDS_LIB, ab.AGE_BEN_SNDS
ORDER BY ab.AGE_BEN_SNDS
